title: [EPIC] Gaja as universal fediverse server — one backend, three API faces
description: Make ALL three servers (not just gaja) universal fediverse servers. fieldwork provides photo+video+microblog capabilities. fieldwork-db provides media storage and processing. Each server exposes Mastodon+Pixelfed+PeerTube API compatibility layers appropriate to its personality. One crate ecosystem, three server personalities, three client API surfaces.
close_reason: Done: 8 API faces (Mastodon, Pixelfed, Lemmy, PeerTube, Misskey, Funkwhale, Bookwyrm, WriteFreely) across all 3 servers. Shared via fieldwork/fieldwork-db with api-convert.
